'''Vurdon Ka''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Vurdon Ka system/Legends|Vurdon Ka system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It was an idyllic world of mosses and inhabited by the peaceful [[Vuvrian/Legends|Vuvrians]]. It was located along the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. The planet joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by [[22,000 BBY/Legends|22,000 BBY]], and later went on to be apart of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It was conquered by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] prior to the fall of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].
